fields.title: a short name for the file
fields.updated: the date the facts were last checked, like 2026-09-30
fields.sources: a list of where the facts came from

lineSource.message: This fact doesn't say where it came from. End the line with its own source in parentheses, like "(planning email, Priya Raman, 2026-09-18)".

learned.foldMessage: learned.md has {count} words. Past {limit}, say so in one line and offer to fold its entries into the main context files at the next setup refresh.

header.message: Start learned.md with a short line saying Loupe proposes these entries and a person approves each one.

learned.unknownFieldMessage: "{field}:" is not an entry field. The fields are kind, source, applies and replaces.
learned.strayMessage: Each line after the header is an entry starting "- ", or one of its fields, indented, like "  kind: fact".

sentence.message: Write each entry as one plain sentence, ending with a period.

kind.message: This entry needs "kind: fact" (about the team, product or systems) or "kind: rule" (how the team wants stories written).

source.message: This entry needs a full source: who said it, how, on which story, and the date, like "source: Priya Raman, correction on skip-a-box, 2026-10-02".
source.dateMessage: The date in this source must be a real date like 2026-10-02.

applies.message: "applies:" must say when the entry holds, from a start to an end, like "applies: 1 December to 5 January".

replaces.message: "replaces:" must quote the earlier fact exactly, in double quotes.
replaces.notFoundMessage: "replaces:" quotes "{quote}", but no other context file or earlier entry says that. Quote the earlier fact exactly, and check learned.md together with the other context files.
replaces.duplicateMessage: Two entries replace "{quote}". Keep one, or have the newer entry replace the older one.

messages.noFrontMatter: The file must start with front matter between two "---" lines.
messages.badDate: "{field}" must be a real date like 2026-09-30.
messages.noSources: "{field}" must list at least one place the facts came from.
messages.tooLong: The body has {count} words; the limit is {limit}. Keep only what a new team member needs.
messages.secret: This looks like {what}. Remove it. Context files must never hold secrets, credentials or customer data.
messages.stale: Last updated {date}, {days} days ago. Check the facts are still true, then update the date.
